summary: Completed testing of two NEW features: (1) Highlight Notes - users can attach/edit/clear personal notes on saved highlights, (2) Highlight Sharing - share button opens dialog with canvas-rendered branded quote card. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly.

Backend: GET /api/highlights returns note field correctly
Backend: PUT /api/highlights/{id}/note - owner can set note (200)
Backend: PUT /api/highlights/{id}/note - empty string clears note
Backend: PUT /api/highlights/{id}/note - >500 chars rejected (422)

Backend: PUT /api/highlights/{id}/note - missing id gets 404
Backend: PUT /api/highlights/{id}/note - unauthenticated gets 401
Frontend: Highlight card displays note with edit button when note exists
Frontend: Highlight card displays 'Add note' button when no note
Frontend: Note editor opens with textarea and character counter
Frontend: Save note button persists note to backend
Frontend: Note displays correctly after save
Frontend: Note persists after page reload

Frontend: Share button opens quote card dialog
